segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some who bought it despite it being marketed for dry or combination skin, say it removes excess oil and leaves skin glowing without stripping or feeling greasy.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including those prone to winter flaking, mostly say it doesn't dry them out further and even softens rough patches, though one reviewer with dry combination skin says it wasn't right for her and switched brands.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are the largest single group and generally describe it as balancing, neither drying nor making skin oily, with several specifically recommending it for combo or combo/acne-prone skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some who say their skin normally breaks out easily or reacts to shaving, mostly report no burning or irritation and calmer, less red skin; one reviewer with very sensitive skin says it broke her out.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her sixties says it finally gave her clean-feeling skin without dryness, as part of a simple cleanser-and-moisturizer routine.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report fewer breakouts, faster-healing pimples, or no new breakouts at all; dissent is notable, though — multiple reviewers, including two critical reviews, describe it breaking them out, clogging pores, or causing more whiteheads, in one case only when used outside a small test area first.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers say it faded dark spots or post-acne marks, including one whose dark, eczema-related areas improved and another who says it cleared dark spots left by a previous face wash reaction.
concerns.redness: Reviewers describe reduced facial redness, including redness from acne, from shaving irritation, and from a redness-prone skin condition, without the product causing new redness itself.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or greasy-feeling skin generally say it removes excess oil and shine without over-stripping, though one reviewer says she can't tell if it reduces her own oil production since she layers serums and moisturizer afterward.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including several with dry skin, say it cleans without drying out their skin and some describe it as actively moisturizing; one reviewer calls it 'a tad bit drying' but notes she moisturizes right after anyway.

extraits.titre: Excellent for dry acne prone skin
extraits.texte: This is so perfect for my skin. I have VERY DRY and VERY ACNE PRONE skin and it's a disaster most of the time. Other acne products dry my skin out completely to the point of flaking and cracking. This does not. Usually, products meant to keep moisture in your skin end up giving me clogged pores and horrible breakouts. This does not. It is non-drying and non-pore clogging. I love it. I notice it doesn't exactly FIGHT acne but it doesn't CAUSE it like other products. And it doesn't dry my skin out. I use this with the MB seaweed night cream AND MY SKIN IS SO NICE. My skin is not dry at all, and not full of product-induced acne. I do however get hormonal acne and this DOES NOT MAKE IT WORSE like many other products. Keeps it under control. I recommend this to anybody with dry acne prone skin

extraits.titre: My favorite skin product--if you shave your face it's a MUST
extraits.texte: This is the one skincare product I simply can't live without. I have been using it for years and it blows every other toner out of the water hands down–even the ones that cost as much as 3 times the price. I have combination-oily skin that is prone to breakouts as well as extremely sensitive. I also shave my face every single morning, which can do a lot of harm and create redness, welts, and abrasions. This product takes care of all of that. It soothes and relieves my skin and visibly decreases the redness. It clears up my pores and strips dirt from my skin. It leaves me feeling fresh every time. I never leave home without it. I use it in the AM after a morning cleanser–applying evenly to the face and wiping off with a cotton pad (wipe strategically and away from the face to prevent dirt buildups) and follow it with a mattifying SPF moisturizer. I LOVE this brand and I LOVE this product. If you are someone who shaves your face, or someone with sensitive and acne-prone skin, I can't recommend this product highly enough.

I use this every day after washing my face and before moisturizer. It works great to pick any oil or dirt left. I have some dry patches on my nose, but this makes them soft and smooth again. My forehead is very oily. This makes my skin feel soft and smooth without removing too much oil. It never feels tight or burns like other toners. It also smell refreshing and not like alcohol!

I walked into the Ulta in Oswego, IL and Bobby helped me find this after the previous face wash I was using burned my skin. I got the Combo Skin trial pack. This product soothed my skin and got rid of my dark spots. I have been using this for about 4 weeks on my combo skin and I dont think I will ever use anything different! a Must buy!
